visual_review.notes: H3 video. The fork crystal flared, pulsed and rang out in sparks and rings in almost every take although the plate allowed it to brighten only where an action asked. Telling the action to keep it steady did not hold; changing the plate so every crystal keeps one unchanging glow did, for idle_h3_v3 and move_h3_v3. The idle loops the steady stretch 63-123, past an early flare. The attack skips the glowing contact hold 56-73; ranged_h3_v2 skips the swing smear and the ring flash 30-39 and snaps into the held swing; cast_h3_v2 skips the opening flare; hit ends before the glow at 42; defend skips the rejected plates and the morphing turn 11 and 13; death_h3_v2 drops from kneeling to lying, skipping the kneeling flare and the green-fringed fall. Re-matted 2026-10-14 with the green-plate spill limit: the green rims on thin and blurred edges are gone, with the same frames, timing, anchor and scale.
